sourcedFrom: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) (UNKNOWN — no copyright year is printed anywhere in the document)
cleanIntro: Remington's own German-language owner's manual is the only owner's manual the company publishes for the Model 7600, and it is a short book by design: the 7600 has no barrel-off field strip. Remington documents opening the action, clearing it, cleaning the bore FROM THE MUZZLE, and — as the one disassembly in the whole manual — dropping the trigger plate assembly out on its two pins. Every step below carries the German sentence it came from and the page it is printed on, with an English rendering beside it.

steps.title: Safety on — the red ring must disappear
steps.action: Push the cross-bolt safety button behind the trigger across until the RED RING IS NO LONGER VISIBLE.
steps.prose: On a 7600 the red band is the whole indicator. If you can see red, the rifle will fire when the trigger is pressed — Remington states it that plainly.
steps.quote: Aktivieren Sie den Sicherheitsmechanismus, indem Sie den Knopf soweit betätigen, bis die ROTE RINGMARKIERUNG NICHT MEHR SICHTBAR IST.
steps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Wichtige Teile der Waffe — Sicherheitsmechanismus, p.7
steps.quoteEnglish: Engage the safety mechanism by pressing the button across until the RED RING MARKING IS NO LONGER VISIBLE.
steps.warn: Never press the trigger while the safety mechanism is engaged.

steps.title: Magazine out of the receiver first
steps.action: Press the magazine latch forward and draw the detachable box magazine down out of the rifle.
steps.prose: Magazine before chamber, every time. The 7600 feeds from a detachable box, so taking it out removes the supply before you go looking at the chamber.
steps.quote: Drücken Sie die Magazinverriegelung nach vorne und ziehen Sie das Magazin aus der Schusswaffe.
steps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Entladen der Schusswaffe, step 3, p.10
steps.quoteEnglish: Press the magazine latch forward and pull the magazine out of the firearm.

steps.title: Fore-end back slowly until the case mouth reaches the port
steps.action: Draw the fore-end slowly to the rear until the front end of the cartridge is level with the ejection port.
steps.prose: Slowly is the operative word — run the fore-end back hard and the extractor throws a live round across the bench instead of presenting it at the port.
steps.quote: Ziehen Sie den Vorderschaft langsam nach hinten, bis das vordere Ende der Patrone auf gleicher Höhe mit der Auswurföffnung ist.
steps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Entladen der Schusswaffe, step 4, p.10
steps.quoteEnglish: Pull the fore-end slowly rearward until the front end of the cartridge is level with the ejection port.

steps.title: Lift the round out through the port
steps.action: Lift the front end of the cartridge outward and remove it through the ejection port.
steps.prose: It comes out nose-first and by hand. That is the controlled way to clear a chambered centrefire round without cycling it onto the ground.
steps.quote: Heben Sie das vordere Ende der Patrone nach außen und entfernen Sie sie aus der Auswurföffnung.
steps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Entladen der Schusswaffe, step 5, p.10
steps.quoteEnglish: Lift the front end of the cartridge outward and remove it from the ejection port.

steps.title: Look at the chamber and the magazine, both
steps.action: Check the chamber and the magazine to establish whether any cartridges are still in the firearm.
steps.prose: Two places, two looks. Remington repeats this warning at the head of every cleaning procedure in the book, which is a fair signal of how often it gets skipped.
steps.quote: WARNUNG: Prüfen Sie die Kammer und das Magazin, um festzustellen, ob sich noch Patronen in der Schusswaffe befinden.
steps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Entladen der Schusswaffe — warning, p.10; repeated at Reinigen des Laufs, p.11
steps.quoteEnglish: WARNING: Check the chamber and the magazine to determine whether there are still cartridges in the firearm.

steps.title: Action bar lock up, then the fore-end fully back
steps.action: Push the action bar lock upward, then pull the fore-end all the way to the rear to open the action.
steps.prose: With the hammer down the fore-end will not move until the action bar lock is released — that is the button you push up, not a stuck pump. Forcing it is how fore-ends get cracked.
steps.aside: Then: pull the fore-end all the way to the rear to open the action.
steps.quote: Drücken Sie die Action-Bar-Sperre nach oben.
steps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Vorderschaft — Öffnen des Verschlussmechanismus, step 1, p.9
steps.quoteEnglish: Push the action bar lock upward.

steps.title: Prove the bore with a rod, muzzle to port
steps.action: With the action open, push a cleaning rod in at the muzzle and run it right through the barrel until you can see it at the ejection port.
steps.prose: This is Remington's obstruction check and it is a see-it test, not a feel-it test. If something will not push out with the rod, the manual says send the rifle to the factory or an authorised service centre rather than shooting it clear.
steps.caution: Never try to remove an object from the barrel by loading and firing a cartridge. The barrel or the case could burst and cause serious injury.
steps.quote: Schieben Sie die Reinigungsstange vollständig durch den Lauf, bis sie an der Auswurföffnung zu sehen ist.
steps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Lauf — I. Überprüfen des Inneren des Laufs, step 4, p.9
steps.quoteEnglish: Push the cleaning rod completely through the barrel until it can be seen at the ejection port.

steps.title: Clean the bore from the MUZZLE toward the chamber
steps.action: Fit the correct-calibre brush to the rod, wet it with solvent and work the bore — always starting at the muzzle and working toward the chamber.
steps.prose: This is the opposite of the direction most autoloaders and shotguns are cleaned in, and it is the single most 7600-specific instruction in the book. On a pump rifle with no removable barrel the muzzle is the end you can reach with a rod, so that is the end you start from.
steps.quote: HINWEIS: Reinigen Sie immer den Lauf ausgehend von der Mündung bis zur Kammer.
steps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Reinigen des Laufs — note after step 4, p.11
steps.quoteEnglish: NOTE: Always clean the barrel starting from the muzzle and working to the chamber.

steps.title: Patches until they come out clean, then oil and wipe back dry
steps.action: Swap the brush for a correctly sized patch tip and push patches through, a fresh one each pass, until no dirt shows. Then a patch wet with Rem Oil, then a clean dry one to take the excess back off.
steps.prose: The last dry patch is not optional housekeeping — oil left standing in a bore is what the next shot drives ahead of it.
steps.caution: After cleaning, make sure the barrel is free of any foreign object.
steps.quote: Wiederholen Sie den Vorgang mehrmals und verwenden Sie jedes Mal einen neuen Lappen, bis kein Schmutz mehr sichtbar ist.
steps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Reinigen des Laufs, step 6, p.11
steps.quoteEnglish: Repeat the process several times, using a new patch each time, until no more dirt is visible.

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: Magazine out, action open, bore clean and proved clear. That is the whole strip Remington publishes for the Model 7600 — this rifle has no barrel-off field strip, and the manual documents none.
steps.prose: Keep the oil film thin from here. Remington's whole lubrication instruction for this rifle is one line, and it says a thin film is enough. The one disassembly the book does publish — the trigger plate assembly on its two pins — is in the deep clean.
steps.quote: Vermeiden Sie stets ein übermäßiges Auftragen von Schmiermittel. Ein dünner Film Rem™ Oil genügt, um Rosten zu verhindern.
steps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Ölung und Wartung, p.11
steps.quoteEnglish: Always avoid applying excessive lubricant. A thin film of Rem™ Oil is enough to prevent rust.

deepSteps.title: Safety on, action CLOSED before the pins come out
deepSteps.action: Engage the safety so the red ring is out of sight, then close the action. The trigger plate comes out with the bolt forward, not with the action open.
deepSteps.prose: Closed and safe is a precondition, not a preference — the trigger plate carries the cocked hammer, and dropping it out of an open action puts a live hammer in your hand.
deepSteps.quote: Aktivieren Sie den Sicherheitsmechanismus. DIE ROTE RINGMARKIERUNG IST NICHT SICHTBAR.
deepSteps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Reinigen der Abzugsplatteneinheit, step 1, p.12
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Engage the safety mechanism. THE RED RING MARKING IS NOT VISIBLE.
deepSteps.warn: Make sure there are no cartridges in the magazine or the chamber.

deepSteps.title: Tap out the front and rear trigger plate pins
deepSteps.action: Drift the front and rear trigger plate pins out of the receiver with a punch.
deepSteps.prose: Two pins, and they are the only thing holding the fire control in the gun. Support the receiver so you are driving the pin rather than bouncing the rifle on the bench.
deepSteps.quote: Klopfen Sie die vorderen und hinteren Abzugsplattenstifte heraus.
deepSteps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Reinigen der Abzugsplatteneinheit, step 3, p.12
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Tap out the front and rear trigger plate pins.

deepSteps.title: Rear of the trigger plate up, then out of the receiver
deepSteps.action: Lift the rear of the trigger plate assembly and take it out of the receiver.
deepSteps.prose: Rear first — it hinges out that way. Lever it straight down and the front of the plate fouls the receiver.
deepSteps.quote: Heben Sie die Rückseite der Abzugsplatteneinheit an und entfernen Sie sie aus dem Rahmen.
deepSteps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Reinigen der Abzugsplatteneinheit, step 4, p.12
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Lift the rear of the trigger plate assembly and remove it from the receiver.

deepSteps.title: Clean the trigger plate as ONE unit — do not take it apart
deepSteps.action: Spray the trigger plate assembly with Rem Oil as shown, let it drain fifteen minutes, spray again to flush the loosened residue out, then shake the excess off.
deepSteps.prose: It is cleaned assembled and it stays assembled. Remington gives no procedure for stripping the plate and states that any adjustment to the trigger or the trigger plate assembly is factory or authorised-service-centre work.
deepSteps.caution: Every adjustment to the trigger and to the trigger plate assembly must be carried out at the factory or by an AUTHORISED REMINGTON SERVICE CENTRE.
deepSteps.aside: Spray the trigger plate assembly with Rem™ Oil as shown in the manual's figure 14, and let it drain for 15 minutes.
deepSteps.quote: HINWEIS: Reinigen Sie die Abzugsplatteneinheit als Einheit mit Rem™ Oil.
deepSteps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Reinigen der Abzugsplatteneinheit — note after step 4, p.12
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: NOTE: Clean the trigger plate assembly as a unit with Rem™ Oil.

deepSteps.title: Before it goes back: disconnector under the left connector
deepSteps.action: Check that the end of the disconnector sits UNDER the end of the left connector before you offer the plate back up to the receiver.
deepSteps.prose: This is the one thing that can be assembled wrong and still go together. Get that relationship backwards and the rifle will not reset between shots — check it while you can still see it, because once the plate is in the receiver you cannot.
deepSteps.quote: Stellen Sie sicher, dass sich das Ende des Trennhebels unter dem Ende des linken Verbinders befindet.
deepSteps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Reinigen der Abzugsplatteneinheit, step 6, p.12
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Make sure that the end of the disconnector is beneath the end of the left connector.

deepSteps.title: Trigger plate back in, pins back through
deepSteps.action: Set the trigger plate assembly carefully back into the receiver, line it up with the holes, and tap the front and rear trigger plate pins home.
deepSteps.prose: Carefully is Remington's word. If the plate does not seat with light pressure, something inside is not where the previous step says it should be — take it back out and look rather than driving the pins against it.
deepSteps.aside: Then: align it with the holes and tap the front and rear trigger plate pins in.
deepSteps.quote: Setzen Sie die Abzugsplatteneinheit vorsichtig in den Rahmen ein.
deepSteps.cite: Bedienungsanleitung — Bedienungshandbuch für: Modell 7600 Zentralfeuer-Vorderschaftrepetierer — F407218 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Reinigen der Abzugsplatteneinheit, step 7, p.12
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Carefully insert the trigger plate assembly into the receiver.

cleaning.name: BORE — MUZZLE TO CHAMBER
tasks: Fit the correct-calibre brush to the cleaning rod and dip it in gun cleaning solution
Work the brush through the bore several times — always from the muzzle toward the chamber, which is the direction Remington specifies for this rifle
Swap to a correctly sized patch tip and push patches through, a fresh one every pass, until none comes out dirty
Push one clean patch soaked in Rem Oil through the bore
Follow it with a clean dry patch to take the excess oil back out
Wipe a thin film of Rem Oil onto the OUTSIDE of the barrel with a soft clean cloth
Confirm the bore is clear of any foreign object before the rifle goes away

cleaning.name: TRIGGER PLATE ASSEMBLY (deep only)
tasks: Clean the trigger plate assembly as one unit with Rem Oil — Remington publishes no procedure for taking it apart
Spray it, let it drain fifteen minutes, then spray again to flush out what has loosened
Shake off the excess oil rather than wiping into the mechanism
Leave every trigger and trigger-plate adjustment to the factory or an authorised service centre

cleaning.name: STORAGE AND BEFORE THE NEXT OUTING
tasks: Clean and oil the rifle thoroughly before it is stored
Give the external metal surfaces an occasional light film of Rem Oil
Remove the excess oil before the rifle is used again, and rub the chamber and bore thoroughly dry
Keep the film thin — excessive lubricant is the failure Remington names, not insufficient

reassembly: Confirm once more that no cartridges are in the chamber or the magazine.
If the trigger plate assembly was removed, check that the end of the disconnector sits under the end of the left connector before it goes back.
Set the trigger plate assembly carefully into the receiver, align it with the pin holes, and tap the front and rear trigger plate pins back in.
Fit the magazine and open the action.
Remove all oil and residue from the chamber and bore before the rifle is loaded and fired.
fncheck: Remington prints no numbered function-check procedure for the Model 7600. What the manual does require, verbatim at p.11, is that before loading you satisfy yourself the bore is clean and clear: "BEVOR SIE DIE SCHUSSWAFFE LADEN: Stellen Sie sicher, dass das Innere des Laufs sauber und frei von Fremdkörpern ist." — in our English, "BEFORE YOU LOAD THE FIREARM: make sure the inside of the barrel is clean and free of foreign objects." Work the safety on and off with the action closed and the rifle empty, and confirm the red ring appears and disappears as the manual describes on p.7; the manual states that with the RED RING VISIBLE and the trigger pressed the rifle fires. Anything that does not behave as described goes to an authorised Remington service centre, which is where the manual sends all trigger and trigger-plate work.
